name: Pieter de Vries
bio:
Pieter's journey into motorsport began in his grandfather's garage, tinkering with classic Mopeds. That early fascination evolved into a passion for precision engineering. After graduating from a vocational school specializing in automotive technology, he joined Vee Masters, quickly proving his aptitude for fabrication and problem-solving.

Pieter approaches his work with meticulous care and a deep understanding of material properties. He's known for his ability to diagnose and repair complex mechanical issues, often devising innovative solutions under pressure. His dedication to quality and willingness to mentor younger team members make him a valuable asset to Vee Masters. His colleagues appreciate his calm, methodical approach, even in the most demanding situations.

What sets Pieter apart is his resourcefulness. Whether it's sourcing rare parts or devising ingenious fixes using available materials, he consistently finds ways to keep the team's vehicles running at peak performance. He also enjoys restoring classic cars in his spare time, applying the same precision and attention to detail he brings to the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Pieter is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting any task.
Has a habit of humming quietly while working on intricate parts.
